guard.ties: r = c passes; exact on integer alert counts (fractions.Fraction)
guard.fallback: static ensemble if fewer than 2 members pass

labels_read: day-2 labels for FP@K; day-1 labels (12-24 h) only to choose chosen_single; member decisions are label-free
chosen_single: lowest FP@K on day 1, 12-24 h, members fitted on day 1, 0-12 h (lof_diag L2b); pool order breaks ties

schemes.transaction: transaction-level: day-2 rows resampled with replacement, same size
schemes.hour-block: the 24 hours of day 2 drawn with replacement, each with all its rows; K recomputed from the resample size

note: ULB is development data for RQ4. A day-block CI is impossible on ULB (one test day); the hour-block scheme is the block analogue.
